items.title: How LeBron James dissected Pacers defense down the stretch
items.summary: How LeBron James dissected Pacers defense down the stretch originally appeared on NBC Sports PhiladelphiaAs he overtook Jason Kidd for the third-most assists in NBA history, LeBron James piloted the Sixers’ offense down the stretch against the Indiana Pacers on Sunday. With Joel Embiid sitting out and Tyrese Maxey getting a breather on the bench, James took over in the fourth quarter. items.title: Wolves Or Grizzlies Likely To Switch To East If NBA Adds Two Teams
items.summary: If the NBA adds expansion franchises in Las Vegas and Seattle, then one current Western Conference team would have to move to the East as part of realignment. The Grizzlies or Timberwolves are considered the most likely teams to switch conferences in that scenario, eight league sources told Joe Vardon, Mike Vorkunov and Sam Amick of The Athletic (free link). “Both of those teams are vying to go east,” one source told The Athletic. As the authors explain, proximity is one reason why those two teams are vying to switch conferences. But the main motivating factor is they think it’ll give them an easier pathway to reach the NBA Finals. The Pelicans are also a candidate to move to the East, but that outcome is viewed as less likely in part because New Orleans is closer to the three Texas teams and Oklahoma City. “I wouldn’t say New Orleans is off the table, because nothing’s been decided…

items.summary: Forward RJ Barrett has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain, the Raptors announced today (Twitter link via Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca). According to the team, another update on Barrett will come in two weeks, which means he’ll miss at least five more games after sitting out Wednesday’s loss to Washington because of the injury.
